description: Implement a nightly ETL pipeline that loads ~500 GB of compressed Parquet data from S3 into Redshift using a staging-table-and-partition-swap pattern. Source: 2,000+ Parquet files in S3 organized by date partitions. Target: Redshift ra3.4xlarge cluster with 2 nodes. Must use COPY with IAM role, transform and validate data in staging, then swap partitions atomically. Risk factors: COPY failure mid-load leaving partial data, insufficient Redshift WLM slots causing queueing, skew in data distribution across slices, vacuum and analyze overhead after swap, and downstream consumer dependency on fresh data by 07:00 UTC. Row-count verification between source (manifest file) and target after every load. Tools available: AWS S3, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, Airflow, dbt, Redshift Spectrum, manifest files.
